services.name: n8n
services.purpose: Workflow automation and external action orchestration after Vaila approval checks.
notes: Use webhooks for workflow execution from Vaila.
Use the public REST API for workflow/execution management when configured.
Do not store credentials in this repository.

services.name: openbrain
services.purpose: External self-hostable memory layer evaluation for semantic recall, graph links, and MCP-compatible memory access.
notes: Treat as an external memory provider, not the only source of truth.
Home Jane remains the memory authority until conflict/sync rules are implemented.
Do not auto-write durable memory without Vaila approval policy.

services.name: github
services.purpose: Version history, review checkpoints, and later automated backup/update workflows.
notes: Keep private memory and credentials out of git.
Use GitHub as history, not as the runtime owner of Vaila.
